wood.name: Wood
wood.text: Plain wood from common trees. Most things start with it.

stone.name: Stone
stone.text: Rough stone. Walls, tools, the odd sling.

etherwood.name: Etherwood
etherwood.text: Pale and cold to the touch. Nobody agrees on why its leaves grow blue.

silver-ore.name: Silver ore
silver-ore.text: Grey rock threaded with bright silver.

malachite.name: Malachite
malachite.text: Green banded stone. Jewellers and alchemists both want it.

gold-ore.name: Gold ore
gold-ore.text: Gold in grey rock. Worth the sweat.

red-crystal.name: Red crystal
red-crystal.text: Deep red, and warmer than a stone should be.

birch-bark.name: Birch bark
birch-bark.text: Papery bark. Burns well and folds into almost anything.

acorns.name: Acorns
acorns.text: Oak seeds. Pigs, squirrels and a few recipes want them.

resin.name: Resin
resin.text: Sticky pine resin. Seals, glues and burns.

brown-mushroom.name: Brown mushroom
brown-mushroom.text: A plain brown mushroom. Safe to eat, probably.

red-mushroom.name: Red mushroom
red-mushroom.text: Red with white spots. Don't eat it. Alchemists might.

blue-mushroom.name: Blue mushroom
blue-mushroom.text: Pale blue. Grows where old magic runs close to the ground.

crab-shell.name: Crab shell
crab-shell.text: A pinchwarden's shell, still a little sandy, and a little proud.

boar-hide.name: Boar hide
boar-hide.text: A grumbletusk's hide. Rough, bristly, still grumpy somehow.

sea-glass.name: Sea glass
sea-glass.text: Glass worn smooth by the sea.

toxolotl-frill.name: Toxolotl frill
toxolotl-frill.text: Soft, slick and faintly glowing. Alchemists keep them in jars.

bear-pelt.name: Bear pelt
bear-pelt.text: Thick and heavy, with bark-like plates in the fur.

prowler-fang.name: Prowler fang
prowler-fang.text: Long, curved, with a faint green rune at the root.

dragon-scale.name: Dragon scale
dragon-scale.text: Small, red and warm, like a coal that forgot to burn.

seed-bread.name: Seed bread
seed-bread.text: Dense, nutty, still warm. One slice and you could walk all day.

mint-tea.name: Mint tea
mint-tea.text: Sharp and clearing. Your head feels lighter.

smoked-claw.name: Smoked crab claw
smoked-claw.text: Salty, chewy, and somehow it makes you want to hit things.

minor-health-potion.name: Minor health potion
minor-health-potion.text: Red and faintly fizzy. Closes small cuts as you watch.

health-potion.name: Health potion
health-potion.text: Deep red and thick. Tastes of iron.

spirit-tonic.name: Spirit tonic
spirit-tonic.text: Pale blue, cold, and it hums.

energy-draught.name: Energy draught
energy-draught.text: Bitter and bright. Your legs stop complaining.
